answer: Each agent earns a reputation score recorded on the shared ledger, increasing only when it signs a time‑locked lantern token after a random interval; the score rises slowly like a ridge, rewarding long‑lived honest behavior. The protocol forces any new identity to start at the nadir of zero reputation and to pay a cryptographic proof‑of‑work stake for every reputation point, so an attacker must bootstrap thousands of fresh IDs each at high cost.
